extracted.name: Marcia's Famous Sticky Buns
extracted.description: Marcia's famous sticky buns recipe is what you want if you need a sweet treat for the morning. Start it the night before, and most of the work is done.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 ounce) package frozen dinner roll dough
1 (5 ounce) package instant vanilla pudding mix
instruction_lines: Sprinkle nuts in the bottom of a greased Bundt pan. Lay frozen roll dough on top of nuts. Sprinkle pudding mix, brown sugar, and cinnamon over dough. Pour melted margarine over mixture. Lay a damp paper towel over the pan and place it in a cold oven for 8 hours to overnight.
Remove the pan from the oven in the morning. Discard the paper towel.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes. Remove from the oven and let sit for a few minutes, then invert onto a plate.
